summary: Frontend testing for three features: (1) Language search on /language screen, (2) Language search in settings modal (PickerModal in settings.tsx), (3) GuestRecoveryModal structure review. All core features work correctly.

details: Search 'tam' → only Tamil shows (Hindi and others hidden) ✅
Clear button (×) resets list to full 22 languages ✅
testID: language-search, language-no-results, lang-{code} all functional
Settings screen loads without crash at /settings ✅
Tap Language row → modal opens with search input at top ✅
Search 'kan' → Kannada (and Konkani, also contains 'kan') show; Hindi hidden ✅
Select Hindi → modal closes, Settings shows 'हिन्दी · Hindi', toast 'Language set to हिन्दी' ✅
testID: lang-modal-search, opt-{code}, lang-modal-no-results all functional
Select language → tap Continue → navigates to /how-it-helps ✅
GuestRecoveryModal component: visible=false renders nothing (Modal visible=false) ✅
GuestRecoveryGate in _layout.tsx only shows modal for guest users with prior sessions ✅
For registered test user (voicetest2026@example.com), modal never appears ✅
Auto-close logic: when scopes empty + not loading → closes after 600ms ✅
testID: guest-recovery-modal, recovery-modal-close, recovery-done-btn all present

critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx PickerModal: search 'kan' returns both Kannada AND Konkani (Konkani contains 'kan'). This is correct behavior — not a bug.
GuestRecoveryGate is properly placed in _layout.tsx after GC removal comment. Only fires for is_guest users with prior scope recordings.
GuestRecoveryModal uses loadedRef.current to prevent re-loading on re-render (good pattern).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Language search works on both /language screen and settings modal. The settings screen is at /settings (not a tab directly) — accessed via Me tab → Settings row (testID: me-me.settings). The settings tab testID in the bottom bar is 'tab-me'. PickerModal in settings.tsx has lang-modal-search and lang-modal-no-results testIDs. GuestRecoveryModal was not live-tested (registered user, not guest) but code structure is correct.
